name: Kalo Mystic
body:
KALO MYSTIC
CR 5

XP 1,600
Kalo mystic 6
NG Medium monstrous humanoid (aquatic)
Init +3; Senses low-light vision, sonar; Perception +13

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 13, flat-footed 14 (+3 Dex, +4 armor)
hp 42 (6d8+0+6+6)
Fort +2, Ref +5, Will +9
Resist cold 5; Weaknesses water dependent

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., swim 50 ft.
Melee +1 underwater heavy mace +5 (1d8+1 B)
Ranged zero pistol +7 touch (1d8 cold, 50-ft. range incr., semi-automatic)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 6th; concentration +10)

Constant—speak with animals
At will—mindlink
4/day—entangle (DC 15)

Spells (CL 6th; concentration +10)

2nd-level (4/day)—fog cloud, mind thrust II (DC 16), resist energy, see invisibility, summon monster II
1st-level (5/day)—air bubble, alarm, command (DC 15), mind thrust I (DC 15), protection from evil 0 (at will)—daze (DC 14), detect magic, mage hand, message, stabilize, telekinetic projectile

STATISTICS

Str 10 (+0), Dex 16 (+3), Con 11 (+0), Int 8 (–1), Wis 18 (+4), Cha 12 (+1)
Base Atk +4; CMB +4; CMD 17
Feats Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, Technologist, Toughness
Skills Diplomacy +10, Knowledge (nature) +15, Perception +13, Spellcraft +8, Stealth +2 (+6 in water), Survival +15, Swim +7; Species Modifiers +4 Stealth in water
Languages Common, Kalo; speak with animals
SQ connection (xenodruid), connection powers (animal adaptation 6 min./day), healing touch 3d6 (7/day)
Gear microcord armor, zero pistol, +1 underwater heavy mace, kalo water rebreathing apparatus, other gear

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Sonar (Ex)

You have an innate sonar ability that grants you blindsight 60 feet if you are underwater against creatures touching the same body of water. Above water, you instead have blindsense to a range of 15 feet. This is a sound-dependent ability and is negated if you cannot hear, such as if you are deafened or under the effect of a silence spell.

ABOUT

Kalos are green-skinned humanoids with membranes between their arms and legs that make them look like manta rays—or some would say bats flying—when they swim through the water. Despite not breathing air, they are naturally curious and outgoing, and have become one of the more active species involved in Galactic trade and exploration. While usually peaceful, they are well-adapted to dealing with the dangers of the icy depths, and are quite valiant warriors when the situation is called for.
